- Measured just now: `git diff --cached` against HEAD shows 6,628 M, 876 D and 29 A. 875 of the D paths exist in the worktree (for example the preset writer and sessionMessageActionReference.ts). Every lane commits through a private index plus commit-tree plus CAS update-ref, which never refreshes the shared index. So each file added to HEAD since the index was last written shows up as a staged delete.
